blocks.text: Siftstone preserves the work of separating and letting something pass through. Its shutters and sieve suggest that history without promising that it can remove every problem from a pet.
A shuttered stone sieve. Turn its handle to empty it.
One-shot use: The shutter opens and a thick bright stream pours out until the dark opening is empty. The game performs the final fade.
24 silver. Digestion / Parasites severity −2; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Health +8; Cleanliness +4. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
